title: Fleet record reconciliation + exception register
description: Extract telematics and maintenance records separately, merge them declaratively, and drive everything that will not reconcile into a source-tagged exception register.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-mob-01
  title: Fleet record reconciliation + exception register
  description: Extract telematics and maintenance records separately, merge them declaratively, and drive
    everything that will not reconcile into a source-tagged exception register.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a fleet operating picture in which every vehicle record ties across systems and every
    unreconciled field is listed with its source rather than averaged away.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Fleet records from operating systems
      summary: Fleet records from operating systems
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - telematics_records
              - maintenance_records
              - fuel_and_job_records
              - period
            properties:
              telematics_records: {}
              maintenance_records: {}
              fuel_and_job_records: {}
              period: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-source1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mob-01
      name: Telematics and utilization extraction
      summary: 'Source extraction 1: telematics and utilization extraction.'
      role: Fleet analyst tying utilization, duty cycles, and maintenance into operating decisions.
      prompt: You are a Fleet Operations Analyst. You combine telematics, duty cycles, and maintenance
        history into vehicle- and route-level operating economics, and you reconcile odometer, fuel, and
        job records against each other rather than trusting one system. You state where the data sources
        disagree instead of averaging them, because the disagreement is usually a process failure worth
        more than the metric.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - data-engineering
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - simulation
          - data-lineage-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:telematics
          - mcp:cmms
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-source2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mob-03
      name: Maintenance and duty-cycle extraction
      summary: 'Source extraction 2: maintenance and duty-cycle extraction.'
      role: Dispatch engineer producing feasible vehicle assignments under hard constraints.
      prompt: You are a Routing & Dispatch Engineer. You produce assignments that respect hours of service,
        vehicle capability, time windows, and depot capacity, and you report which constraint made a request
        infeasible rather than returning a plan that quietly violates one. You give the optimality gap
        for heuristic solutions, because a dispatcher deciding whether to add a vehicle needs to know
        how much is left on the table.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - optimization
          - domain-analysis
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:tms
          - mcp:telematics
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-union
      kind: transform
      name: Merge telematics and maintenance records
      summary: merge the extracted vehicle records on vehicle_id and period
      config:
        operation: merge
        expression: merge the extracted vehicle records on vehicle_id and period
    - id: n-reconcile
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mob-01
      name: Reconcile matched vehicle records
      summary: Reconcile fields that arrived from more than one source.
      role: Fleet analyst tying utilization, duty cycles, and maintenance into operating decisions.
      prompt: You are a Fleet Operations Analyst. You combine telematics, duty cycles, and maintenance
        history into vehicle- and route-level operating economics, and you reconcile odometer, fuel, and
        job records against each other rather than trusting one system. You state where the data sources
        disagree instead of averaging them, because the disagreement is usually a process failure worth
        more than the metric.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - data-engineering
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - simulation
          - data-lineage-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:telematics
          - mcp:cmms
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-exceptions
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mob-06
      name: State the unreconciled records as exceptions
      summary: Everything that could not be reconciled, stated as an exception.
      role: Incident analyst reconstructing events and separating cause from correlation.
      prompt: You are a Mobility Incident Analyst. You reconstruct an incident from vehicle, infrastructure,
        and human-factors evidence, keeping the timeline separate from the causal claim, and you state
        what the evidence cannot distinguish. You resist single-cause narratives, because the recommendation
        that follows from 'driver error' and from 'a design that invites driver error' are not the same
        recommendation.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - incident-response
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - experiment-design
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:telematics
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-register
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect the exception register
      summary: Every unreconciled field is source-tagged so an exception keeps its provenance.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: n-clean
      kind: condition
      name: Exception register empty?
      summary: Route on register.exceptions is empty.
      config:
        expression: register.exceptions is empty
        branches:
          - label: Clean
            when: clean
          - label: Exceptions
            when: exceptions
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Fleet manager accepts the reconciled operating picture
      summary: Pause for the fleet manager; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Fleet record reconciliation + exception register deliverable, the
        evidence behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-mob-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-source1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-01-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-source2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-01-edge-3
      from: n-source1
      to: n-union
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-01-edge-4
      from: n-source2
      to: n-union
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-01-edge-5
      from: n-union
      to: n-reconcile
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-01-edge-6
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-exceptions
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-01-edge-7
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-register
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-01-edge-8
      from: n-exceptions
      to: n-register
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-01-edge-9
      from: n-register
      to: n-clean
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-01-edge-10
      from: n-clean
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: clean
    - id: wf-mob-01-edge-11
      from: n-clean
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: exceptions
    - id: wf-mob-01-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
